Application Process This is a full-time opportunity for Saudi Nationals. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

8372e6856cb03a27.job_title: QA/QC Lead Engineer Oil and Gas
8372e6856cb03a27.description: About Roland Berger Roland Berger, established in 1967, is a leading consultancy firm with German heritage and European origins. The firm values diversity in cultures, mentalities, and perspectives, believing that diverse teams inspire innovative ideas and new viewpoints. This commitment to authenticity and individuality is central to its operational philosophy. Role Overview: Partner - Oil & Gas Roland Berger is seeking a Partner to lead and expand its Oil & Gas business within the Middle East, with a primary focus on national oil companies and their operating entities. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and requires over 20 years of experience. The Oil & Gas sector is a key growth area for Roland Berger in the region. Key Responsibilities Originate and develop client relationships and consulting opportunities with national and international oil companies, particularly ADNOC and/or QatarEnergy. Build trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior leadership, understanding their strategic priorities and operational challenges. Lead major engagements in areas such as transformation, performance improvement, cost optimization, operating model redesign, operational excellence, and digital/AI transformation. Oversee the successful and profitable delivery of consulting engagements, ensuring high-quality outcomes and client satisfaction. Apply deep Oil & Gas expertise across upstream, downstream/refining and petrochemicals, gas/LNG, and oilfield services. Advise corporate and operating-company leadership across functions including operations, finance, business development, and R&D/technology. Develop the Oil & Gas business pipeline and manage commercial performance, including opportunity identification, proposal development, and profitability. Build and develop the Oil & Gas team and capabilities, recruiting and developing talent to support regional business growth. Collaborate with other Roland Berger practices and global Oil & Gas and Energy teams to leverage expertise and foster cross-border client development. Required Qualifications and Experience 20+ years of relevant professional experience in Oil & Gas consulting or senior industry roles, with significant C-suite interaction. Deep sector expertise across multiple parts of the Oil & Gas value chain, including upstream, downstream/refining and petrochemicals, gas/LNG, and oilfield services. Extensive experience working with national and/or international oil companies at both corporate and operating company levels. Demonstrated experience across multiple functions, including operations, finance, business development, R&D/technology, and corporate functions. Strong track record in transformation, performance improvement, cost optimization, operating model redesign, operational excellence, and digital/AI programs. Proven business development success, with a track record of personally originating, selling, and delivering over USD 10 million in consulting work annually. An established network of repeat clients and senior relationships within relevant national and international oil companies. Minimum of three years of recent professional experience in the Middle East, with substantial exposure to the UAE and/or Qatar markets. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic consulting environment, requiring significant client engagement and team leadership. The position is full-time and based in Riyadh, focusing on expanding Roland Berger's presence in the Middle East Oil & Gas sector. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary for this position is not disclosed.

83524555ecacaed7.description: JASARA provides PMC services within the construction sector, supporting the commercial and operational delivery of major projects. The team works to help projects stay well planned, well managed, and aligned with commercial objectives throughout the project lifecycle. As a Senior Quantity Surveyor, you will play an important role in strengthening commercial performance across complex construction work. This role is focused on providing reliable cost leadership, supporting sound financial decision-making, and helping project teams maintain control over budgets, valuations, and commercial outcomes from tender stage through project delivery. Responsibilities Prepare detailed cost estimates, budgets, and tender documentation for major projects. Monitor project costs, variations, and cash flow against approved budgets. Evaluate contractor claims and negotiate fair commercial settlements. Provide quantity take-offs, measurement, and valuation of completed works. Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline. 10 years of experience in quantity surveying or cost management, including both pre-contract and post-contract exposure. Strong experience managing cost control on large-scale construction projects. Proficiency with cost estimating software, quantity take-off tools, Excel-based commercial models, or contract administration platforms is a plus. Experience negotiating with contractors, working with consultants, or managing commercial discussions with client-side project teams is a plus.

839d01c3d7da4283.description: About the Role ALPLA Group is seeking a Purchasing Administrator to join our team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is essential for managing procurement processes, ensuring timely acquisition of materials and services, and maintaining strong supplier relationships. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience in a purchasing or administrative capacity. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with planning and functional departments to ensure timely requests for necessary items. Prioritize and issue all purchase orders (POs) without delay. Negotiate prices and submit price comparisons to Operations Managers (OMs) for approval. Source various materials and services. Maintain up-to-date supplier records and purchasing databases. Track all POs and provide regular updates to OMs. Implement a system to track goods and services POs to ensure on-time delivery. Identify and report potential risks such as price increases or material shortages due to supplier issues. Update the price matrix on a monthly basis. Ensure a minimum of three suppliers for each item. Maintain accurate records of all purchasing processes. Verify that all purchase orders comply with company policy. Reduce discrepancies between the Purchase Requisition (PSR), Purchase Order (PO), and Goods Receipt (RIR) processes. Order materials and services based on negotiated and approved quotations. Review quotations and report any discrepancies. Maintain current procurement files. Manage petty cash and reconcile reports promptly. Handle all types of purchase orders, including forging and local purchases. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a purchasing or administrative role. Demonstrated ability to negotiate prices and manage supplier relationships. Proficiency in maintaining accurate records and databases. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work effectively with various departments. Work Environment and Benefits Working with ALPLA Group offers a modern and family-oriented work environment. The Purchasing Administrator will be integrated into a dynamic team, undertaking challenging tasks with a high degree of self-responsibility. Individual performance is recognized and supported for further development.

83a99c7fe53d8fe2.description: About the Role Huxley is urgently seeking an Enterprise Data Architect for a 1-year extendable contract. This role is based onsite in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a global technology consulting and digital transformation firm. Role Overview This position requires a hands-on Data Architect with robust technical expertise in enterprise data architecture, data modeling, and data integration. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing enterprise-wide data architectures, defining data models and standards, and supporting the development of scalable data platforms. Key Responsibilities Design enterprise-wide data architectures. Define data models and establish data standards. Support the development of scalable data platforms. Translate business requirements into effective data solutions. Create architecture artifacts and develop data roadmaps. Collaborate closely with technical teams on data integration and ETL initiatives. Required Experience and Qualifications Demonstrated technical expertise in enterprise data architecture. Strong background in data modeling. Proficiency in data integration techniques. Experience in translating business requirements into data solutions. Ability to create architecture artifacts and roadmaps. Experience working with technical teams on integration and ETL initiatives. Experience in consulting environments is advantageous. Prior involvement in projects within Saudi Arabia is advantageous. Contract Details This is a 1-year contract position, with the possibility of extension. The start date for this role is immediate. Location The position is based onsite in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

8344fa9b8f24aba7.description: About the Role Zamil Services is seeking an experienced Fire Protection Technician to join their team in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves hands-on experience in the installation, inspection, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting of various fire protection systems. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience and strong technical knowledge in this field. Role Overview The Fire Protection Technician will be responsible for ensuring the proper operation and compliance of fire protection systems across construction projects and maintenance contracts. This includes working with Fire Alarm, Firefighting, Fire & Gas Detection, and Fire Suppression Systems. The role requires the ability to interpret engineering drawings and apply technical standards effectively. Key Responsibilities Install, inspect, maintain, and repair fire protection systems, including Fire Alarm, Fire & Gas Detection, Fire Sprinklers, Fire Pumps, Fire Hydrants, and Fire Suppression Systems. Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, schematics, and installation instructions. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to ensure proper system operation. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to fire protection equipment and systems. Conduct periodic inspections and functional testing of fire protection systems. Install, maintain, and troubleshoot FM-200 and other fire suppression systems. Monitor system performance and make necessary adjustments. Perform technical activities on construction projects and maintenance contracts based on project requirements. Prepare inspection reports, maintenance records, and testing documentation. Ensure compliance with applicable safety procedures, technical standards, and regulations. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in the Fire Protection field. Proven experience in Fire Alarm Systems, Firefighting Systems, or both. Strong knowledge of fire protection equipment, including Fire Pumps, Fire Sprinklers, Fire Hydrants, FM-200 Systems, Smoke Detectors, and Heat Detectors. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation. Experience in installing, testing, maintaining, and troubleshooting fire protection systems. Previous experience in Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) projects and industrial projects. Experience working on construction projects or maintenance contracts. Required Skills Familiarity with fire protection testing equipment and tools. Ability to work safely at heights and in confined spaces. Good communication and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of fire protection safety procedures and applicable standards. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time Fire Protection Technician position with Zamil Services.

8388fdb2f4287891.job_title: Manager Operational Readiness - Planning and Reporting - 50011075 - DA3
8388fdb2f4287891.description: JOB PURPOSE Build a single, decision-ready view of programme delivery by integrating Primavera P6 schedules with automated Power BI analytics and executive PowerPoint reporting. Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced planning and reporting professional who combines hands-on Primavera P6 capability with a strong consulting mindset. The role will establish, integrate and govern complex schedules, automate schedule intelligence through Power BI, and convert detailed project controls data into concise PowerPoint reporting for senior leadership. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable working at activity level with planners and workstream owners, and at executive level with decision-makers. Key Responsibilities Core Responsibilities A. Primavera P6 Schedule Establishment & Control Develop, structure and maintain integrated master schedules in Primavera P6 across projects, operational readiness workstreams and key interfaces. Establish fit-for-purpose enterprise project structures, WBS, activity coding, calendars, logic, milestones, constraints and baselines. Integrate construction, testing and commissioning, handover, operator mobilisation, operational testing, test events and Day 1 readiness activities. Validate schedule quality, including logic integrity, open ends, constraints, lags, calendars, float paths and critical or near-critical activities. Run update cycles, progress validation, variance analysis, forecasting, scenario modelling and schedule recovery planning. Establish clear controls for schedule ownership, change management, data cut-off, status dates, approvals and baseline governance. B. Power BI Schedule Analytics Design and implement Power BI data models and dashboards using Primavera P6 exports and approved project data sources. Automate progress, milestone, critical path, float, variance, slippage, look-ahead, risk and dependency reporting. Develop drill-down views from portfolio and programme level to project, workstream, WBS and activity level. Create clear data definitions and reconciliation controls so the dashboard remains aligned with the approved P6 schedule. C. Executive PowerPoint Reporting Produce concise, consulting-quality PowerPoint packs for leadership forums, steering committees and executive reviews. Translate schedule data into clear messages on performance, critical decisions, key risks, interdependencies and required interventions. Develop standard reporting pages such as executive summary, milestone outlook, critical path, two-week look-back and look-ahead, trend analysis, decision log and recovery plan. Ensure every report has a clear storyline, evidence-based conclusions, accountable owners and decision-focused asks. Generic Responsibilities Lead planning workshops with project teams, consultants, contractors, operators and functional stakeholders to establish credible plans. Challenge assumptions constructively and identify gaps between delivery completion and operational readiness. Define planning and reporting standards, templates, RACI, reporting calendars, quality checks and governance routines. Coach schedule owners and reporting contributors to improve planning maturity, data quality and accountability. Provide independent, fact-based advice to senior stakeholders and escalate material schedule risks with practical recommendations. Key Deliverables: Approved scheduling framework, coding structure, planning calendar and schedule governance procedure. Integrated Primavera P6 master schedule with agreed baselines, interfaces, milestones and critical path visibility. Power BI executive dashboard with documented definitions, refresh process and reconciliation controls. Standard monthly and fortnightly PowerPoint reporting pack for executive governance forums. Critical path, milestone, two-week look-ahead, risk, dependency, change and recovery reporting. Capability transfer materials and practical coaching for schedule owners and reporting contributors. Measures of Success Leadership receives a timely and consistent view of schedule performance, emerging risks and decisions required. All major milestones, dependencies and critical paths have clear ownership and traceable source data. Power BI and PowerPoint outputs reconcile to the approved Primavera P6 schedule. Manual effort and reporting cycle time are reduced through automation and standardisation. Schedule quality, update discipline, forecasting credibility and stakeholder accountability improve over time. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, Data Analytics or a related discipline. Professional Certifications Preferred: PMP, PMI-SP, AACE, PSP or equivalent professional certification. Skills Primavera P6 (Expert): Build and govern integrated schedules, baselines, logic, coding, progress updates and critical path analysis. Power BI (Advanced): Build data models, transformations, DAX measures and executive dashboards from schedule data. PowerPoint (Advanced): Create concise, decision-focused leadership packs with clear storylines and executive messages. Excel (Advanced): Perform reconciliations, quality checks, reporting automation and structured analysis. Consulting (Advanced): Structure ambiguous problems, facilitate workshops, challenge assumptions and present recommendations. Project Controls (Expert): Apply schedule governance, change control, forecasting, variance analysis and recovery planning.

8392f79f83cfea58.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مطعم عائض للوجبات السريعة عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب من شاغل الوظيفة إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بكفاءة ودقة، بالإضافة إلى ضمان رضا العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع التأكد من توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع معتمدة أخرى، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة للعملاء. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها وفقاً للإجراءات المتبعة. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني وودود، وتلبية رغباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع العملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الصندوق ضمن فريق مطعم عائض للوجبات السريعة في جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمواعيد العمل المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

839d14e295c11e56.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني هندسة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة النظم والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى دعم مهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب النظم والمعدات الإلكترونية، مثل الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات، ومراقبتها بشكل مستمر. تحديد المخططات ونوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الهندسية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين المشاركين في تركيب النظم الإلكترونية. اختبار النظم بعد تركيبها لضمان التزامها بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية المحددة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالمعدات الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات كفني هندسة إلكترونية أو في مجال مشابه. فهم قوي لمبادئ النظم الإلكترونية وتركيباتها. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها وتشخيص الأعطال. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع المهام. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم المساعدة التقنية والتنسيق مع الزملاء. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في ينبع، المدينة المنورة، ويعمل بنظام الدوام الكامل. ستتاح للمرشح الفرصة للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات، والمساهمة في مشاريع تركيب وصيانة النظم الإلكترونية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم.

839e047597b98a31.description: About the Role InnovationTeam is seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic software and IT services engagements for key customers in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role combines delivery leadership, customer relationship management, commercial discipline, and governance. The Senior Project Manager will be accountable for managing complex, business-critical technology projects from initiation through successful delivery and closure, ensuring alignment with contractual commitments, customer expectations, quality standards, and organizational objectives. This position requires providing senior-level leadership to multidisciplinary delivery teams, proactively managing project risks and dependencies, and maintaining clear, decision-oriented communication with customer executives and internal leadership. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex IT projects and programs, developing and managing integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, budget, resources, dependencies, quality, and acceptance criteria. Manage project budgets, cost controls, financial performance, and resource utilization, while tracking revenue milestones and contractual obligations. Govern project change requests and scope modifications, ensuring all changes are evaluated, estimated, approved, and contractually aligned. Coordinate resource planning with PMO, engineering, operations, and supporting teams, managing project staffing requirements and allocation plans. Build and maintain strong customer relationships, leading governance meetings, steering committees, and acting as the primary escalation point for project-related matters. Coordinate activities across software engineering, QA, DevOps, architecture, infrastructure, security, business analysis, and external vendors. Apply Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery methodologies, ensuring adherence to Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes. Manage external vendors, partners, and subcontractors, monitoring performance and ensuring deliverables meet agreed quality and timelines. Develop and execute recovery plans for challenged projects, addressing schedule slippages, quality concerns, and budget overruns. Ensure successful project closure and operational handover, capturing lessons learned and validating contractual completion. Contribute to the enhancement of PMO frameworks, tools, templates, metrics, and governance practices. Support business development and pre-sales activities, contributing delivery estimates, assumptions, risks, and resource plans. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. A master's degree in business, technology, or project management is an advantage. Professional Experience: Minimum of 10 years of total professional experience in software, technology, digital transformation, or IT services environments. At least 6 years of direct project management experience with accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, and customer outcomes. Proven experience managing complex software development or systems integration projects through the complete lifecycle.
